I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she wrote that Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel gives no street address or other site details, and I couldn't see any Tansley account files, so I told him that's all there is.
